sources.entry: Tunnelblick - Tunnelblick is a graphic user interface for OpenVPN on macOS.

summary.one_liner: Tunnelblick is a free, open source graphical user interface for OpenVPN on macOS for controlling OpenVPN client and/or server connections.
summary.what_it_does: Tunnelblick provides a graphical interface for OpenVPN on macOS. It offers easy control of OpenVPN client connections and/or server connections. The README is short and mostly links out to the official website, the source repository, and contributing and localization guides. It also describes the project's policies for bug reports, pull requests, and security issues. It does not document specific features or setup steps.
use_cases: connect to an OpenVPN server on a Mac
manage OpenVPN client connections with a GUI
run an OpenVPN server on macOS
control VPN tunnels from the macOS menu
open source VPN client for Mac
notable: Graphical user interface layered over OpenVPN on macOS
Supports both OpenVPN client and server connections
Bug reports go to a Discussion Group, with GitHub Issues also accepted
Pull requests not accepted for translations or localization
caveats: Runs only on macOS, as the description names only macOS
The README does not include installation or run instructions; the official website is linked instead
Localization and translation contributions are handled outside pull requests
